The '''Imperial frontline camp''' was a military outpost established by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Special Operations Group Three]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located at the entrance to the region along the [[Main Prisoner Transfer]] roadway.
